==Enemies==
'''King''' may refer to these [[Enemies]]:
*[[Awakened Fallen King]], the major boss of the [[Hidden Wave]]
*[[Fallen King]], a major boss that first appears on wave 40 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
*[[Fallen King (Legacy)]], a major boss that first appears on Wave 48 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode
*[[Necromancer King]], a high health summoner enemy that first appears on Wave 23 in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]
**[[Necromancer King/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Slow King]], a high health enemy that first appears on Wave 37 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode and Wave 38 in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode
*[[Slow King (Legacy)]], a high health enemy that first appeared on Wave 41 in [[Hardcore Mode]]
*[[Speedy King]], a fast enemy that speeds up nearby enemies upon death that first appears on Wave 39 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] Mode
*[[Speedy King (Legacy)]], a fast enemy that speeds up nearby enemies upon death that first appeared on Wave 43 in [[Hardcore Mode]]

'''King''' may also refer to these removed [[Enemies]]:
*[[Nuclear Fallen King]], a major boss that first appeared on Wave 40 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode in [[Polluted Wasteland]]
